notes.title: Patch Notes for v13.21
notes.notes:
•	Fixed a couple typos here and there.
•	You can now pet the dog in the tutorial.
•	Small adjustments to Charlie’s story.
•	The pronoun question now has a “still figuring that out,” response.
•	Amara no longer gives you praise if you don’t deserve it.
•	During puzzles, characters no longer deliver the same affirmation back to back.
•	Force Wave no longer consumes mana until it’s used.
•	Force Wave’s spell slot changes to CANCEL when targeting so you know you can cancel it.
•	The menu has been reworked a little.
•	Friends Journal now has a helpful hint to let you know to click on people.
•	Friends Journal now 'blings' when you meet someone new, to remind you to go look.
•	Game's cursor is now all nice and fancy.
•	Title screen now has Demo and Beta tags to let you know more clearly what build you're in.
•	NEW TITLE SCREEN WOOOOO!

notes.title: First demo update!
notes.notes:
During our streamer-only week we released a couple of updates, including the addition of Story and Archmage modes and the inclusion of a spice-level warning. Then we took the game to the Seattle Indies Expo, where we got a ton of useful feedback and got to see the parts of the game that folks stumbled over a little. This patch contains a host of small improvements aimed at streamlining the new-player experience.

v13.18
[list]
[*] Puzzle pieces move faster when you're swapping them.
[*] Equipped spells now have a little burst vfx when you get enough mana to cast them and have an ongoing effect as long as that remains true.
[*] Equipped spells and magic styles now have tooltips on the Spell selection screen.
[*] The puzzle 'time' element no longer incorrectly appears just as you beat eh second tutorial puzzle.
[*] Cassie now acts every 2 turns instead of every 4.
[*] Typhon's unstable gems now do a little pulse after every turn to remind you that they're there.
[*] Cassie's first chapter can now happen at the lake and waterfalls. The castle is a bit of a bottleneck in the early game so it's helpful to be able to meet characters in other places.
[*] Clicking anything now immediately kills the tooltip.
[*] Shooting stars' trails remain longer.
[*] Careful Study had wonky vfx. Made something a little better.
[*] Fixed a bug (I think) where sometimes a level would end in success, but the Score bar wouldn't be filled.
[*] Slightly lowering the required points of the third tutorial level.
[*] The very end of the tutorial now has a response where you can tell Riley that you're poly, so all of this is normal for you.
[/list]

We're eager to keep improving so please continue sending us feedback, through Discord or by leaving a review.
